meta.task: Build me a checkout page for an online store

defs.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
defs.genInstructions: Build a horizontal step indicator across the top showing Cart Review → Shipping → Delivery → Payment → Confirm, with completed/current/upcoming states and clickable completed steps. It orients the user and lets them jump back to edit an earlier stage.
defs.role: It is the navigational spine of the checkout flow, indicating and controlling which stage form the user is currently focused on.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When the address form passes validation and is submitted/saved, it emits a 'shipping-complete' event with the saved address; the stepper marks the Shipping step complete and advances the current step to Delivery.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
effectors.description: When card/payment fields validate successfully, it emits 'payment-complete'; the stepper marks Payment as complete and moves the active step to Confirm.

effectors.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
effectors.description: On clicking Place Order, the sidebar emits 'order-submitted'; the stepper marks all steps complete and sets the Confirm step to the active/success state.

targets.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
targets.description: Clicking the Shipping step emits stepId='shipping'; the address form scrolls into view, expands, and focuses its first input while other sections collapse to summary rows.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: Clicking the Delivery step emits stepId='delivery'; the selector expands into its active editable state and scrolls into view.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
targets.description: Clicking the Payment step emits stepId='payment'; the payment form expands, scrolls into view, and focuses the card number field.

targets.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
targets.description: Clicking the Cart Review step emits stepId='cart'; the items panel expands to full editable list view and scrolls into view.

defs.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable list of cart line items with thumbnail, title, variant, unit price, quantity stepper, remove button, and a 'save for later' action, plus an empty state. It lets the shopper verify and adjust exactly what they are buying before paying.
defs.role: It is the editable manifest of goods being purchased, feeding quantities and prices to the order totals.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
effectors.description: Receives stepId='cart' when the Cart Review step is clicked and expands to its full editable list view, scrolling into view.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
targets.description: On any quantity change, item removal, or save-for-later, emit the updated line-item array (id, qty, unitPrice, weight); the sidebar recomputes subtotal, tax, shipping eligibility, and grand total and re-renders the totals rows and item count badge.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: Emits updated cart contents (total weight, item count, oversized/perishable flags); the selector re-evaluates which shipping speeds are available and updates their prices and ETA estimates.

defs.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a labeled form with contact email/phone, full name, address lines, city, state/region, postal code, country select, autocomplete suggestions, saved-address picker, 'billing same as shipping' toggle, and inline validation. It captures where the order ships.
defs.role: It collects and validates the destination details that drive delivery options, tax, and order submission readiness.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
effectors.description: Receives stepId='shipping' and expands/scrolls into view with focus on the first empty input.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
targets.description: On successful validation and save, emits 'shipping-complete' with the address object so the stepper completes the Shipping step and advances to Delivery.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: On country/postal code change or address save, emits the destination; the selector re-queries carrier options and refreshes available methods, rates, and delivery date estimates for that region.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
targets.description: Emits the validated address plus a boolean form-valid flag; the sidebar renders the ship-to summary line, recalculates region-based tax, and enables/disables the Place Order button accordingly.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
targets.description: When the 'billing same as shipping' toggle is on, emits the address so the payment form's billing-address fields auto-populate and collapse; unchecking re-opens them empty.

defs.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
defs.genInstructions: Build a set of selectable radio cards for shipping speeds (standard, express, overnight, store pickup) each showing carrier, price, and estimated delivery date, plus a gift/delivery-note field. It lets the shopper choose how fast and how the order arrives.
defs.role: It converts the shipping address and cart contents into a chosen shipping rate that feeds the order total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the destination country/postal code and refreshes the list of available methods with region-specific rates and ETAs; unserviceable options are disabled.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
effectors.description: Receives updated cart weight, item count, and special-handling flags and recomputes each method's price and ETA, hiding methods the cart is ineligible for.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
effectors.description: Receives stepId='delivery' and expands into its editable state, scrolling into view.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
targets.description: On selecting a method, emits {methodId, label, cost, etaDate}; the sidebar updates the Shipping row amount, the grand total, and the estimated arrival line.

defs.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a payment section with method tabs (card, wallet, PayPal, gift card), card number/expiry/CVC fields with live card-type detection and a card preview, billing address block, save-card checkbox, and inline validation plus security badges. It captures and validates how the order is paid.
defs.role: It secures the funding method and validation state required before the order can be placed.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When 'billing same as shipping' is enabled, receives the address object and auto-fills/collapses the billing address block; when disabled, clears and re-opens the fields.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
effectors.description: Receives stepId='payment' and expands, scrolls into view, and focuses the card number field.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
targets.description: On successful field validation emits 'payment-complete' so the stepper marks Payment done and activates Confirm.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
targets.description: Emits the selected payment method label, masked card last-4, and a payment-valid boolean; the sidebar shows the pay-with summary line and enables the Place Order button only when valid.

defs.name: Checkout: Order Summary And Place Order Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a sticky right-hand sidebar with condensed item thumbnails and count, promo code input with applied-discount chips, subtotal/discount/shipping/tax/total rows, ship-to and pay-with summary lines, estimated arrival, terms checkbox, and a large Place Order button with loading and error states.
defs.role: It is the financial and commit surface that aggregates every other component's state into a final total and submits the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
effectors.description: Receives the updated line-item array on any quantity/removal change and recomputes subtotal, tax, and total while refreshing the condensed item thumbnails and count.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: Receives {methodId, cost, etaDate} on selection and updates the Shipping row, estimated arrival line, and grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the validated address and form-valid flag; renders the ship-to line, applies region tax, and gates the Place Order button.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
effectors.description: Receives the payment method label, masked last-4, and payment-valid flag; renders the pay-with line and enables Place Order only when payment is valid.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper
targets.description: On Place Order click emits 'order-submitted'; the stepper marks all steps complete and sets Confirm to its success state.
